title: Knots in 3D: Graphing the Over-Under Trefoil Knot in Desmos
description:
Knots in 3D: Graphing the Over-Under Trefoil Knot in Desmos

In this Desmos 3D Masterclass, we explore 3D Wireframe & Mesh Engines using pure multivariable calculus and linear algebra inside the Desmos Graphing Calculator.

📐 Mathematical Architecture:
- Core Formula: x = \sin t + 2\sin 2t, \quad y = \cos t - 2\cos 2t, \quad z = -\sin 3t
- Concepts: Knot Theory, Torus Knots (2,3), Space Curves
- Pedagogical Lesson: The trefoil knot is the simplest non-trivial knot, classified as a (2,3)-torus knot. It wraps around a torus twice in one direction and three times in the other without intersecting itself.
